test_cases.title: Successful login with valid credentials redirects to dashboard
preconditions: User account exists with email user@example.com and known password
test_cases.expected_result: Server returns authentication token, client navigates to dashboard URL, dashboard loads without errors
test_cases.automation_reason: Straightforward UI flow; can be automated with Selenium/Appium and API token validation

test_cases.title: Password field masks input characters
test_steps: Observe that characters appear as bullets or asterisk
test_cases.expected_result: Password input type is "password" and characters are hidden
test_cases.automation_reason: Can be validated by checking input element attribute and visual rendering via UI automation

test_cases.title: Invalid credentials display generic error message
preconditions: User account exists with email user@example.com
test_cases.expected_result: Error message is visible, descriptive, does not reveal which field is incorrect, and follows UI guidelines
test_cases.automation_reason: Error toast can be captured and text validated via UI automation

test_cases.title: Non‑existent email triggers generic error message
test_cases.expected_result: Same generic error message as for wrong password; does not disclose that email is not registered

test_cases.title: Client‑side validation rejects malformed email format
test_cases.expected_result: Client displays validation error before submitting request (e.g., "Enter a valid email address")
test_cases.automation_reason: Can verify presence of validation message without network call

test_cases.title: Client‑side validation prevents empty password submission
test_cases.expected_result: Client displays password required validation error and does not send request to server
test_cases.automation_reason: Validation message can be captured via UI automation

test_cases.title: Brute‑force protection locks account after max failed attempts
test_steps: Repeat the following 5 times: Enter email "user@example.com", enter wrong password "Wrong1!", click Login, verify error message
On 6th attempt, enter correct password "ValidPass123!" and click Login
test_cases.expected_result: After 5 failed attempts, account is locked; 6th attempt shows lockout message and no authentication token is issued
test_cases.automation_reason: Loop can be scripted; lockout message detection is automatable

test_cases.title: Login response time under load meets performance SLA
test_steps: Simulate 200 concurrent login requests with valid credentials
Measure average response time and 95th percentile
Assert that average response time ≤ 2 seconds and 95th percentile ≤ 3 seconds
test_cases.expected_result: Login endpoint responds within defined performance thresholds
test_cases.automation_reason: Can be executed with JMeter/Gatling scripts; results captured automatically
